text:
alex: Heads-up — for the SF hub onsite next week we’re piloting a Family Lounge + temporary subsidized parking passes for caregivers. Quick bullet points below, form link at the end.

maya: Amazing, thank you! A few Qs. Is the parking only Mon-Fri?

alex: Yes — passes cover Mon–Fri 8am–8pm during the onsite window. Weekend parking is standard rates.

devin: What qualifies as a caregiver for the stipend? Is it paid sitters too?

alex: Good Q. 'Caregiver' = immediate family OR paid caregiver (nanny, sitter, elder care) while you’re onsite. Stipend: up to $150/day, up to 3 days. Must submit receipts to Expensify and tag expense category "family-onsite".

ryan: Do we need manager approval to use the stipend?

alex: No manager approval required for the stipend itself — just submit receipts. If you’re requesting additional special accommodations (e.g., extended days beyond the 3-day cap) talk to People Ops and your manager.

facilities: Lactation room 3B is set aside as the Family Lounge during the pilot (lockers, changing table, small fridge). Bookings via: https://cal.redwood/lactation-3B. We’ll have white-noise machines and a privacy screen.

maya: Any onsite vetted sitter list?

alex: We’ll share a vetted provider list tomorrow (background-checked vendors only). Note: Redwood is not underwriting sitter contracts — the stipend helps offset costs.

devin: If someone needs accessibility parking or an ADA spot, is that separate?

facilities: ADA parking requests — DM facilities with your badge #. We’ll reserve an accessible spot; that doesn’t use the daily subsidized pass.

maya: :thumbsup: thanks alex & facilities.

devin: Shuttle question — can we get an extra stop at 4th & Market? That’s closer for a few parents.

ops-bot: shuttle-schedule: temporary stop added at 4th & Market for Thu–Fri of the onsite week; calendar invites updated.

ryan: Nice. How do I claim the parking pass?

alex: Fill this short request form: https://tiny.redwood/family-pass. We’ll email a QR pass within 48 hours of approval. Passes are first-come-first-served.

maya: If I need an exception (more than 3 days) who do I contact?

alex: DM People Ops (me) with dates & reason. We’ll review case-by-case.

ryan: Will the Family Lounge have quiet toys / play mats?

facilities: Yes — small play mat, bins of toys sanitized daily. Please keep the space tidy for others.

devin: Thanks — filing the form now.

alex: Quick reminder — receipts go to Expensify and must include provider name, date, and amount. Tag "family-onsite". For privacy, receipts are only seen by People Ops and Finance.

maya: Appreciate the privacy note.

alex: Thanks everyone. We’ll post the vetted sitter list and the FAQ doc tomorrow. Ping me for urgent needs.
